get.description: HR-only. Returns the authenticated recruiter?s tracked candidates with their latest available assessment result.

put.description: HR-only, idempotent. Adds the candidate to the authenticated recruiter?s tracked list.

delete.description: HR-only. Removes the candidate from the authenticated recruiter?s tracked list.

get.description: Returns assignments visible to the authenticated user: assignments created by the recruiter or assigned to the candidate.

post.description: HR-only. Assigns an available discipline and target-grade assessment to a candidate.
